summary: Frontend testing completed for 3 new features: 1) Event Details Sales Rep Assignment, 2) Overtime Weekly Entry Mode, 3) Regulatory Reports Section. All features are working correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (María González employee, TSS report for Feb 2026)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 requested features are working: 1) Event Details page shows 'Assigned Sales Rep' card with selector dropdown showing active employees with user_id and commission rates, 2) Overtime section has improved dialog with 'Entry Mode' selector - 'Single Day' and 'Full Week' modes, weekly mode shows 7-day table with 35% and 100% columns, 3) People Ops > Reports tab shows DGT-3/TSS/IR-17/606 report cards with generate dialog and preview functionality including export to Excel.

details: Sales rep card visible with data-testid 'sales-rep-card'
Shows 'Assigned Sales Rep' label with current assignee name
Select dropdown shows 'Unassigned' and active employees with user_id
Employee commission rate displayed as badge (e.g., 5%)
Commission info text shown below card when sales rep with commission is assigned
Dialog has 'Entry Mode' selector with 'Single Day' (default) and 'Full Week' options
Single Day mode: Date picker, Hours 35% input, Hours 100% input
Full Week mode: Week start picker, 7-day table (Mon-Sun) with 35%/100% columns per day
Week Total row shows accumulated hours
Reason textarea and Cancel/Submit buttons present
Reports tab visible in People Ops navigation
Four report type cards: DGT-3 (Quarterly), TSS (Monthly), IR-17 (Monthly), 606 (Monthly)
Each card shows: Name, Entity, Description, Frequency badge
'Generate Report' button opens dialog with Report Type, Year, Period selectors
Generated Reports table shows history with Type, Period, Generated date, Employees, Total, Actions
View action opens preview dialog showing summary cards (Employees, Total Salaries, Total Contributions) and detail table
Download Excel button available in preview
